package main

import (
	"fmt"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/ast"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/core"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/parser"
	"github.com/microsoft/TypeScript/tsc/shim/tspath"
	"github.com/system-inc/cohere/internal/lint/rule"
	rules "github.com/system-inc/cohere/internal/lint/rules/typescript"
	"os"
)

func main() {
	source := "const r = foo!.bar;"
	path := "/tmp/subject.ts"
	file := parser.ParseSourceFile(ast.SourceFileParseOptions{FileName: path, Path: tspath.Path(path)}, source, core.ScriptKindTS)
	subject := rules.NoNonNullAssertion
	count := 0
	incompatible := false
	listener := subject.Run(rule.Context{SourceFile: file, FileCache: rule.NewFileCache(), Report: func(d rule.Diagnostic) {
		count++
		fmt.Printf("%s finding %d %d %s\n", subject.Name, d.Range.Pos(), d.Range.End(), d.Message.Id)
		for _, s := range d.Suggestions {
			fmt.Printf("suggestion %s edits %d\n", s.Message.Id, len(s.Fixes))
			for _, f := range s.Fixes {
				fmt.Printf("edit %d %d %q\n", f.Range.Pos(), f.Range.End(), f.Text)
			}
			if len(s.Fixes) != 1 || s.Fixes[0].Range != d.Range {
				incompatible = true
			}
		}
	}}, nil)
	var walk func(*ast.Node)
	walk = func(n *ast.Node) {
		if visit := listener[n.Kind]; visit != nil {
			visit(n)
		}
		n.ForEachChild(func(child *ast.Node) bool { walk(child); return false })
	}
	walk(file.AsNode())
	if count != 1 || !incompatible {
		fmt.Fprintln(os.Stderr, "suggestion gap changed")
		os.Exit(1)
	}
	fmt.Println("shared oracle rejects this with: unexpected suggestion shape")
}
